about: A candidate playbook for ab-run (deck@variant) and runner/ab.py --data: the wretch candidate (version 1) with answer rules and with the cards its engine rules starved given places in the order. Only the playbook object is read.

playbook.notes: Version 2 = the wretch candidate (version 1: its attack and both trigger rules unchanged) with eleven rules added and the base's nineteen cast rules kept in their relative order (base rules 1-5 are rules 1-3, 6, 7; base 6 is 12; base 7-12 are 16-21; base 13 is 23; base 14 is 25; base 15 is 26 with five cards added; base 16-19 are 27-30). Written from the 200 tables of ab-run #27 (seed 20261260, pool bots-v2 under their playbooks), where the candidate won 41 and the stock pilot of the same deck 46. WHAT WAS WRONG. A play or activate rule with something to do always goes before a card no rule names, so under version 1 the cards it did not name were starved: Incremental Blight cast in 10 of 54 games drawn (stock 49 of 56), Aberrant Return 16/62 (51/66), Liliana 8/56 (34/53), Binding the Old Gods 8/42 (30/44), Puppeteer Clique 24/60 (46/52), Chain Reaction 14/59 (41/67), Midnight Banshee 18/61 (36/54); the seat lost holding 4.9 nonland cards. Black Sun's Zenith and Fire Covenant (AI:RemoveDeck:All) were never cast by either pilot and were in hand at 38 and 42 of the candidate's losses, Soul Snuffers (cast 2 of 64) at 37. On the seat's last own turn of a loss the median board was 2-3 creatures of ours against 10-11 for the widest opponent, at 10-15 life. THE CONDITION FOR A WIPE THAT HITS US TOO: the widest opponent has six or more creatures and more power than we have, and we have three creatures or fewer: by the logs' creature counts it held on one of the last three own turns in 113 of 159 losses and 10 of 41 wins (first true on own turn 7, median); or that opponent has more creatures than we have and could kill us next turn. RULES 4-5, Chain Reaction (X = every creature on the battlefield, so at six or more opposing creatures it kills nearly all of them) and else Black Sun's Zenith for all the mana (x max, at least 3), on those conditions, above the commander: Auntie would die to them, so she is cast after. RULE 8, the wipes that spare most of our side, once an opponent has four creatures: Village Pillagers (1 wither damage to each opposing creature: with Auntie each is also a life lost), Soul Snuffers (a counter on every creature: our side draws a card each through Auntie, the other side's x/1s die and each opposing creature costs its controller a life), Midnight Banshee (a counter on each nonblack creature every upkeep; Auntie is black). Below the commander so turn 4 stays Auntie's. RULE 9, Carnifex Demon's {B} ability (a counter on every other creature), never used by either pilot, with Auntie out and an opponent wider than us with four or more. RULES 10-11, Liliana's -3 (destroy a creature with a -1/-1 counter: Forge picks it) and else her +2, since an unnamed planeswalker ability is also starved. RULE 13, Binding the Old Gods (chapter I destroys an opponent's nonland permanent) and Incremental Blight: Forge's own logic aims the Blight, so the rule casts them when Forge agrees; after the engines (rule 12). RULE 14, Skinrender while an opponent has a creature. RULE 15, Blowfly Infestation once an opponent has three creatures (the base's hold, released at two, stays). RULE 22, the threats before the draw spells while an opponent has more power than we have: the base drew while being attacked to death (hand of six on turn 8). RULE 24, Eventide's Shadow as a draw spell only with 40 cards left, 25 life and three cards or fewer in hand (it costs a life a counter; the base's hold stays). RULE 26, the base's threats with Liliana, Ferrafor, Aberrant Return, Midnight Banshee and Puppeteer Clique added: none of them was named by a rule. Not written: Fire Covenant (its X is paid in life, which a rule cannot set, and Forge's logic declined it every time it was offered in the local tables: 0 casts in 4 games drawn, so it was taken out of rule 13);  Vraska's -2 (Forge's targets; the base's +0 rule still takes her every turn), the instants (Infernal Grasp, Putrefy, Terminate, Assassin's Trophy, Cathartic Pyre are cast by Forge on other players' turns in 92-98% of games already).
